state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What is the daily meal allowance for an intern on a client-site day in Paris today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q5: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip whose stay includes a Saturday night today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: home-office equipment allowance an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week
state.step_intent: Find the home-office equipment allowance that applies to: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today?

passages.source: HB-31 §2 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Exception for employees with a medical accessibility plan | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: For employees with a medical accessibility plan, the home-office equipment allowance is 600 EUR instead of the standard amount. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.

passages.source: HB-31 §3 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to part-time employees working fewer than 20 hours a week; they follow the standard home-office equipment allowance in HB-33 §2. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.source: HB-33 §3 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-14
passages.text: For employees who work remotely four or more days a week, 150 EUR is added to the standard home-office equipment allowance. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.

passages.source: HB-14 §3 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-03-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-33
passages.text: For employees who work remotely four or more days a week, 150 EUR was added to the standard home-office equipment allowance. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.

passages.source: HB-30 §3 | Policy FAQ — Current home-office equipment allowance | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard home-office equipment allowance? A: 325 EUR, as set in HB-33 §2 (effective 2026-06-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-31.
